It is a member of 2-aminopurines, an oxopurine and a purine nucleobase. It derives from a hydride of a 9H-purine.

items.title: Guanosine Monophosphate
items.description: Guanosine 5'-monophosphate is a purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate having guanine as the nucleobase. It has a role as a metabolite, a biomarker, a mouse metabolite and an Escherichia coli metabolite. It is a purine ribonucleoside 5'-monophosphate and a guanosine 5'-phosphate. It is a conjugate acid of a guanosine 5'-monophosphate(2-).

The latest CryoKit revision introduces a fully 3D printed design with a reduced component set to improve reproducibility and ease of assembly. 

Compared to version 2.4.7, the Float, Claw Locks, Clips, and Bottom Rack have been removed, retaining only the Top Rack, which has been redefined as the Insert. This Insert remains cross-compatible with the V2.4.7 design. 

The device is distributed with a revised user manual and is intended to provide a more streamlined and standardized approach to cryopreservation.
